answer: Each agent posts a 44 POA ember bond that loses 4 per epoch unless renewed by a fresh yarrow yield reading. A saffron stamp on the bond fades as it decays, and the public saffron table shows what remains. 1,000 fakes lock 44,000 POA and burn 10,000 per epoch; one honest agent pays 44 once and 6 per epoch. Bought bonds fail too: the stamp stays bound to the planter's history, and transfer restarts decay at full speed.
